title: Euterpe紧急通知
content: 由于Euterpe修改了OAuth认证方式，1.4.5与1.4.6可能会出现无法登录的情况。可以加入喵斯兔交流群获取测试版使用（331568783）或前往Euterpe官网下载谱面。正式版喵斯兔正在打磨中，预计在6月10日左右完成更新。感谢您的支持与理解。
content_en: Due to Euterpe changing its OAuth authentication method, login failures may occur in versions 1.4.5 and 1.4.6. You can join the MuseDashTOOL QQ Group (331568783) to obtain the beta version, or download charts directly from the Euterpe official website. The official version of MuseDashTOOL is currently being polished and the update is expected to be released around June 10. Thank you for your support and understanding.

title: v1.4.8更新!
content:
1、增加了谱面下载的查重功能，如果本地已经存在重复的谱面会弹窗提醒。可以在设置中关掉此功能。
2、谱面管理界面新增谱面查重功能，快速查看本地存在的同名谱面并且可以选择删除或快速删除
3、更新了更为详细的使用教程。原使用教程现改为【关于】界面
4、修复了导入图片模式后的UI适配问题
5、重构了Euterpe界面的oauth认证方式。
6、大幅优化了谱面管理界面的打开速度
content_en:
1. Added a duplicate check feature for chart downloads. A pop-up will notify you if a duplicate chart already exists locally. This can be disabled in Settings.
2. Added a duplicate chart checking feature in Chart Manager to quickly view local charts with the same name and choose to delete or quickly delete them.
3. Updated to a more detailed tutorial. The original tutorial has been renamed to the 'About' panel.
4. Fixed UI layout adaptation issues after importing background images.
5. Refactored the OAuth authentication for the Euterpe interface.
6. Significantly optimized the opening speed of the Chart Manager interface.

title: 热重载自制谱模组更新！
content: 可以在游戏运行时往游戏添加/删除自制谱了？加入331568783喵斯兔交流群，获取最新测试版热重载自制谱模组！
content_en: You can add or delete custom charts while the game is running?Join the MuseDashTOOL communicate group:331568783,get the latest CustomAlbums which allows you to hotreload!

title: 紧急修复
content:
请在北京时间5月26日23：30以前使用了一键安装自制谱的用户，重新点击一键安装自制谱按键，否则会导致：
[Red]在自定义分组内打出成绩的谱面移出分组后成绩会消失[/Red]
如无影响或在这个时间之后一键安装的用户可忽视这条公告。
content_en:
Users who used 'One-Click Install Custom Charts' before 23:30 (UTC+8) on May 26, please click the button again to reinstall. Otherwise, it will cause:
[Red]Scores achieved on charts within a custom group to disappear after moving the chart out of the group.[/Red]
Users unaffected or who installed after this time can ignore this announcement.
